_hinweis: Erkennungsmusik für „Zwischen den Zeilen“. Erzeugt mit Eleven Music (kommerziell nutzbar ab Starter-Plan). Gleicher Stil für alle Stücke, damit die Folge wie aus einem Guss klingt. Neu erzeugen: node werkzeuge/musik.mjs --neu NAME. Seit 27.11.2026 „Redaktions-Beat“ (vorher Indie-Pop mit Akustikgitarre – laut Rückmeldung „Wartezimmermusik“).
stil: head-nodding boom bap hip-hop beat at 92 bpm built from newsroom sounds: punchy dusty kick, crisp cracking snare, hi-hats made of rhythmic typewriter key clicks, a typewriter carriage-return bell 'ding' as the signature accent, a deep warm upright bass riff, and one catchy five-note hook played on a chopped vibraphone. Cool, confident, slightly cheeky, warm vinyl character, dry tight studio mix, bold and memorable, not background music, instrumental only

stuecke.name: thema
stuecke.prompt: An 8-second podcast opening theme. Starts immediately with the full beat and states the main hook twice, then ends on one tight, clearly resolved final hit with a short natural tail so a voice can start right after. No fade-in, no fade-out.

stuecke.name: outro
stuecke.prompt: A 12-second podcast outro. The same beat and the same main hook return at full energy, play the hook twice, then break down to the signature final hit and a natural ending. No long fade.
